category_ja: 馬の品種・性別・年齢
working_definition_ja: 雨や含水量の多い走路・馬場で相対的に高い適性や競走能力を示す馬の特性。
notes: REG-SRC-012 and REG-SRC-014 support Mudlark as an AU/NZ label for horses that excel in wet/heavy conditions. This is horse aptitude, not a track-condition state.

preferred_ja: 楽に追走している状態
working_definition_ja: 競走中、騎手から強い促しを受けず余力を保って走っていると評価される状態。
notes: REG-SRC-012 Under double wraps and REG-SRC-013 On the bit/bridle support regional commentary usage. Do not generalize to all equestrian meanings of on the bit.

working_definition_ja: 競走中、馬が速度や位置を維持・向上するため騎手から明確な促しを受けている状態。
notes: REG-SRC-013 Off the bit/bridle supports this regional race-commentary state as the contrast to travelling easily.

working_definition_ja: 特定の馬・選択肢に多くの投票・賭金が集まり、市場で強く支持されている状態。
notes: REG-SRC-012 supports Backed off the map as heavy public backing. Price movement is not required by the source-backed core definition.

working_definition_ja: 特定の馬または組合せへ投票支持が極端に集中し、他の選択肢との差が大きい市場状態。
notes: REG-SRC-003 supports JRA 一本かぶり. Keep distinct from generic Favorite and from merely strong backing; model as narrower than BET-043 Strong betting support.
